notes: All eleven entries register state-name bindings only: cdecl, zero stack arguments, void result, confirmed by original decompiles and return instructions. The unchanged typed registry core supplies Patricia trie and array algorithms; callback pointers are data, not owned actor logic. Parent registrations retain their declared whole-code boundaries.
